posts.seeking.label: People looking for work
posts.seeking.description: Top-level posts in the first 7 days of the Who wants to be hired? thread

removed_share.seeking.label: Seeker posts removed
removed_share.seeking.description: Share of Who wants to be hired? posts deleted or removed within the first 7 days

seekers_per_post.hiring.label: Job seekers per hiring post

replies_per_post.hiring.label: Replies per hiring post

salary_disclosed_share.hiring.label: Posts that state a salary
salary_disclosed_share.hiring.description: Share of hiring posts with a salary or salary range the parser can read

salary_min_median_usd.hiring.label: Median salary floor

salary_max_median_usd.hiring.label: Median salary ceiling
salary_max_median_usd.hiring.description: Median upper bound of stated salary ranges, annual USD, among posts that state one

remote_token_share.hiring.label: REMOTE in the header
remote_token_share.hiring.description: Share of hiring posts with REMOTE in the first line

onsite_token_share.hiring.label: ONSITE in the header
onsite_token_share.hiring.description: Share of hiring posts with ONSITE in the first line

visa_share.hiring.label: Mentions visa sponsorship
visa_share.hiring.description: Share of hiring posts that mention visa sponsorship

new_company_share.hiring.label: First-time posters
new_company_share.hiring.description: Share of hiring posts from a company not seen in any earlier month

returning_company_share.hiring.label: Posted last month too

ai_native_share.hiring.label: Posts describing an AI product
ai_native_share.hiring.description: Expected share of hiring posts that describe their product as built on AI or ML

new_grad_share.hiring.label: Posts open to new grads
new_grad_share.hiring.description: Expected share of hiring posts open to new graduates or junior engineers

eng_leadership_share.hiring.label: Posts hiring engineering leads
eng_leadership_share.hiring.description: Expected share of hiring posts that hire engineering managers or leads

interns_token_share.hiring.label: Posts mentioning interns

seeker_mood.seeking.label: Job-seeker mood

seeker_strained_share.seeking.label: Job seekers who sound strained

work_mode.label: How companies want people to work

sources.name: Hacker News hiring threads
sources.measures: Employer posts in the monthly “Ask HN: Who is hiring?” thread and posts from people looking for work in “Who wants to be hired?”, read in the first 7 days. The job-seeker thread began in May 2014.
sources.lag: None: each issue reads that month's threads once their first week is over.
sources.caveat: A startup-leaning panel, not the market: it skews toward venture-backed companies, engineering roles and the Bay Area, many posters are outside the US, and one post can list many roles.
